reviews.note: Strong rating with a large review volume.

daycares.inspectionNote: Only 2 High (both 2023, none recent), 8 Medium High spread over 5 years, 0 Medium, no injuries. Most recent visits (June-July 2026) fully compliant. Best inspection record scored so far.

daycares.name: Pinnacle Montessori of Alamo Ranch

reviews.note: Mostly glowing for PreK, but one detailed recent review describes an infant-room supervision incident (unsupervised infants, an uncaught scratch).

daycares.inspectionNote: Worst record scored: roughly 30 High, 28 Medium High, 10 Medium across ~85 visits since 2021, unusually frequent inspections suggesting repeated complaints. High-severity findings as recent as May 2026. No injuries recorded despite the volume. Lowest score of the group.

daycares.name: The Pillars Christian Learning Center - Reed

reviews.note: Strong rating (4.6, 163 reviews); one review specifically mentions a child starting in the infant room at 7 weeks old.

daycares.inspectionNote: 2 High (most recent March 2026), 7 Medium High (most recent April 2026), 3 Medium, across just 22 months of records - no injuries, but no recent clean stretch to point to yet.
